name: io.github.Fractal-Neurons/pacta
title: Pacta, by Fractal Neurons
description: Fractal Neurons: contract checks for 316 DeFi protocols on Ethereum & Base (189 Base-EAS attested)

tools.name: pacta_lookup_protocol
tools.description: Resolve a protocol or token name to Pacta's verified record: canonical slug and page URL, checksummed primary contract and controller, classification with its evidence basis (Base-EAS-attested vs RPC-observed only), and ready-to-use preflightArgs {chain, address} for pacta_check_preflight. 316 protocols + 17 briefs, answered in memory (no RPC). Free in every pricing mode.

query.description: Protocol or token name, symbol, slug or 0x address (e.g. 'Aave', 'Ethena', 'USDe', 'Moonwell', 'kUSD'). Empty or '*' lists what Pacta tracks.

caller_agent.description: Optional identifier of the calling AI agent, IDE, or framework (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'coinbase-agentkit', 'elizaos', 'langchain', 'chatgpt', 'gemini', 'openclaw', 'custom-agent'). Omitted or invalid values never block a call (inferred from known client headers or 'unspecified'). Lowercase slug only; never include personal names, emails, or secrets.

requester_role.description: Optional: high-level role category of the requester or system running this check (closed enum; no personal data).

caller_purpose.description: Optional: operational workflow context for this pre-execution check (closed enum).

tools.name: pacta_check_preflight
tools.description: One-call pre-execution safety check of a contract before an agent interacts with it: verdict (no controller found / timelock / zero-delay timelock / multisig / EOA admin / unclassified / undeployed) with the checks run, 0-100 risk score (null when not determined: no contract, or NO_CONTROLLER_FOUND), proxy + implementation, controller kind, zero-delay upgradeability and pause / blacklist / upgrade capabilities, pinned to a block. Free (no key, no payment).

block.description: Block to pin: "latest" (default), a decimal block number or 0x-hex

caller_agent.description: Optional identifier of the calling AI agent, IDE, or framework (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'coinbase-agentkit', 'elizaos', 'langchain', 'chatgpt', 'gemini', 'openclaw', 'custom-agent'). tools.name: pacta_submit_request
tools.description: Opt-in: queue a coverage or feature request with Pacta when a target is not indexed, a chain or check is unsupported, or data looks wrong (coverage_gap_hint). Ask the user first. Free in every pricing mode, 5 per hour; an identical request_type + target_subject upvotes the existing request (same request_id). Returns request_id, status, demand_votes and an optional fast_track_url. Never opens a GitHub issue. Pass contact_handle ONLY when the user explicitly asks for follow-up or an invoice.

caller_agent.description: Optional identifier of the calling AI agent, IDE, or framework (e.g. 'claude-code', 'cursor', 'windsurf', 'coinbase-agentkit', 'elizaos', 'langchain', 'chatgpt', 'gemini', 'openclaw', 'custom-agent'). Omitted or invalid values never block a call (inferred from known client headers or 'unspecified'). Lowercase slug only; never include personal names, emails, or secrets.

requester_role.description: Optional: high-level role category of the requester or system running this check (closed enum; no personal data).

caller_purpose.description: Optional: operational workflow context for this pre-execution check (closed enum).

request_type.description: What is missing: a protocol, a chain, a check surface, a doc/data discrepancy, or an MCP/API feature.

target_subject.description: Protocol / token slug, chain name, or chain:0xAddress the request is about (e.g. 'pendle-v2', 'arbitrum', 'base:0x...').

requested_capability.description: One sentence: the specific data, check or feature needed. No secrets, keys or personal data.

urgency_track.description: community_queue_free (default, free), active_due_diligence, issuer_urgent_review (issuer re-verification, scoped by arrangement), api_high_volume_sla.

forum_proposal_url.description: Optional https:// link to the governance forum proposal this request concerns.

contact_handle.description: Optional work email, Telegram @handle, or GitHub handle ONLY if the human user explicitly asks for follow-up or an invoice. NEVER guess or populate without explicit user consent; never pass keys or secrets.
